$comment: Usage budget across lanes (retro H3, AIE-R28). Read by scripts/agents/budget.mjs; rules and wiring in docs/agents/BUDGET.md. All caps are per UTC day. Scheduled lanes together may use daily_total times (1 - reserved_interactive_share); the rest is kept for interactive build work, which is never blocked. Unknown cost counts as over budget. The numbers are proposed defaults, not a founder decision: daily_total.runs equals roster limits.max_runs_per_day_total (30) and cost_usd is 30 runs at the opencode default_budget_usd (2). A lane is matched from the receipt run id: digits = actions, local or local-<n> = local, <lane>~<anything> = that lane.

interactive.$comment: Founder-led build threads. Never blocked; its receipts (run id interactive~<anything>) count against the daily total, so scheduled lanes yield when it runs long.

actions.$comment: GitHub Actions agents.yml runs (run id = GITHUB_RUN_ID, all digits).

local.$comment: dispatch.mjs --local with AGENTS_LANE unset (the 4-hourly scheduled lane runs up to 6 times a day).

freeze-week.$comment: Release freeze: the build thread gets most of the day; docs and PRD lanes stop.

$comment_windows: Each window: { profile, from, until (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC; active from <= day < until), reason, decided_by (a D-id) }. Empty until the founder records a freeze date.
